check_box.tool_tip: Directional fade: rays strengthen when the camera faces the sun. NOTE: takes effect after a shader reload (toggle a graphics preset or relog).

slider.name: godray_multiplier_slider
slider.tool_tip: Godray brightness multiplier. 1-5 is a realistic range; higher for stylized shots.

slider.name: godray_resolution_slider
slider.tool_tip: Raymarch sample count. Higher = smoother shafts, more GPU.

slider.name: godray_falloff_slider
slider.tool_tip: Distance falloff. Higher fades shafts out closer to the camera.

text.value: Shafts appear where shadowed air meets sunlit gaps: shoot from inside structures or under canopy, camera across the light, sun low.

check_box.label: Volumetric Projector Cones
check_box.tool_tip: Visible light shafts from shadow-casting projectors (set lights), shaped by the gobo/projection texture. Requires shadows. Independent of the sun godrays above.

slider.name: projvol_multiplier_slider
slider.tool_tip: Projector shaft brightness multiplier. Primary tuning lever.

slider.name: projvol_resolution_slider
slider.tool_tip: Raymarch samples per cone. Bounded local march - fewer needed than the sun godrays. Cost also scales with the number of shadow-casting projectors.

slider.name: projvol_anisotropy_slider
slider.tool_tip: Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy. Higher = stronger forward-scatter glow when looking toward the light; 0 = even scatter from all angles.

text.value: Only shadow-casting projectors cast shafts (raise Max Spot Shadows on the Shadows tab to promote more). Point the camera toward a set light for the strongest glow.

check_box.label: Pin scene textures (no degrade during takes)
check_box.tool_tip: Holds every scene texture at loaded resolution: no downrez, no unload, alt-tab safe. Disables a memory safety valve - use for capture sessions.

slider.name: bd_near_clip_slider
slider.tool_tip: Camera near-clip plane. 0 = stock (0.1m). Lower stops extreme close-ups clipping through geometry; costs scene-wide depth precision.

check_box.label: Render blended faces as masked (fixes alpha z-fighting)
check_box.tool_tip: Routes alpha-blended surfaces through the masked path: writes depth, sorts as solid, stable shadows, works on no-mod content. Legacy materials only (PBR pending).

check_box.label: Include worn / rigged items (hair, clothing)
check_box.tool_tip: Extends forced masking to rigged attachments. Expect visible changes on alpha hair and clothing - a per-shot judgement call.

slider.name: bd_mask_cutoff_slider
slider.tool_tip: How much texture alpha counts as solid. Lower = more texels pass as solid.

check_box.label: Texture pool
check_box.tool_tip: Decoded textures held in system RAM: re-entering view is a memcpy instead of a disk read + re-decode. Off = stock streaming.

check_box.label: Mesh pool
check_box.tool_tip: Unpacked mesh geometry held in system RAM: re-entering draw distance skips disk + parse + face build. Off = stock.

slider.name: bd_texpool_fraction_slider
slider.tool_tip: Fraction of installed RAM the decoded-texture pool may use (0.5 = ~96GB here). Applies within a few seconds.

text.value: Launch-time performance settings (decode threads, cache I/O threads) live in Debug Settings: search 'BDMerge'.

check_box.tool_tip: Camera aim and roll subtly follow your avatar's head. Bone camera wins if both are set.

slider.name: bd_max_roll_slider
slider.tool_tip: 1 = camera stays level; lower lets more head roll through.

slider.tool_tip: Reduces history where the current and reprojected shaft disagree; higher reacts faster with less ghosting.

check_box.label: Track airborne beam depth
check_box.tool_tip: Reproject temporal history from the shaft's luminance-weighted mean distance instead of the wall behind it.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsDither_slider
slider.tool_tip: 0 = off; 1 = static; 2 = always animated. Temporal anti-banding can safely cycle mode 1 while history is active.

check_box.label: Temporal anti-banding (no extra samples)
check_box.tool_tip: Cycles the static march phase only while temporal accumulation can average it. Disable for an absolutely frozen sampling pattern.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeFroxelWindAzimuth_slider
slider.tool_tip: Wind compass bearing (0=N, 90=E). Direction the dust comes FROM; by default it drifts the opposite way (0 = blows toward south). Shared by froxel air + beam dust.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeFroxelWindElevation_slider
slider.tool_tip: Wind vertical tilt (-90..90). Positive = comes from above so dust settles downward; negative rises.

check_box.label: Invert wind direction
check_box.name: ps_BDMergeFroxelWindInverted_check
check_box.tool_tip: Invert: off = dust blows opposite the bearing (a north wind blows south); on = blows toward the bearing.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsMaxDistance_slider
slider.tool_tip: Maximum visible airborne beam length. 0 follows the projector's full light range; surface illumination is unchanged. Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.1 m steps.

check_box.label: Soft projector shadows (contact-hardening + fill)
check_box.tool_tip: Widen the projector-shadow PCF kernel with receiver distance (sharp at contact, softer far away) and lift shadows off pure black toward a fill floor. Off = classic hard shadows.

check_box.label: Also soften sun/moon shadows
check_box.tool_tip: Apply the same contact-hardening + fill to the sun/moon cascade shadows for a consistent look.

check_box.label: Gobo anisotropic/mip filtering (anti-alias)
check_box.tool_tip: Trilinear-mip + anisotropic filtering on projector cookies plus a screen-space LOD clamp, so gobos stay crisp at grazing angles / distance instead of aliasing. Default on.
